hashString.in: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

zones.name: The Couch Kingdom
zones.blurb: Where every journey starts: the gravitational pull of soft furniture.

zones.name: Iron Foothills
zones.blurb: Rusty racks, heavy things, and people who never re-rack them.

zones.name: Chalk Canyon
zones.blurb: Tall walls. Small holds. Big feelings.

zones.name: Windswept Steppe
zones.blurb: An endless road and a headwind in every direction.

zones.name: Titan's Summit
zones.blurb: The last climb is the one inside.

bosses.name: Snooze Button
bosses.epithet: “Five more minutes.”

bosses.name: Couch Potato
bosses.epithet: Has not moved since the pilot episode.

bosses.name: Elevator Imp
bosses.epithet: Whispers “take the lift” at every staircase.

bosses.name: The Sunday Scaries
bosses.epithet: Lord of “I’ll start Monday.”

bosses.name: Rust Mite
bosses.epithet: Eats neglected barbells.

bosses.name: Ego Imp
bosses.epithet: Adds plates you did not ask for.

bosses.name: DOMS Demon
bosses.epithet: Arrives two days late. Stays for three.

bosses.name: Iron Golem
bosses.epithet: Never skipped a day. Never stretched either.

bosses.name: Greasy Sloper
bosses.epithet: Nobody has ever held it. Nobody.

bosses.name: Pump Wraith
bosses.epithet: Fills forearms with concrete.

bosses.name: Gravity Gremlin
bosses.epithet: Turns it up when you are on the crux.

bosses.name: The Crux Wyvern
bosses.epithet: Guards the last move of every project.

bosses.name: Side Stitch
bosses.epithet: Small. Sharp. Punctual.

bosses.name: Blister Blob
bosses.epithet: Loves new shoes.

bosses.name: Headwind Wraith
bosses.epithet: Somehow blowing from all four directions.

bosses.name: The Wall
bosses.epithet: Lives at kilometre thirty-two.

bosses.name: Pothole Pixie
bosses.epithet: Hides in every shadow on the descent.

bosses.name: Flat Tire Fiend
bosses.epithet: Strikes furthest from home.

bosses.name: Bonk Beast
bosses.epithet: You should have eaten something.

bosses.name: Col du Doom
bosses.epithet: Twenty-one hairpins. Averages eleven percent.

bosses.name: Plateau Giant
bosses.epithet: Flat on top. Goes on forever.

bosses.name: Excuse Hydra
bosses.epithet: Cut one off; two more grow back.

bosses.name: Comparison Specter
bosses.epithet: Shows you everyone else’s highlight reel.

bosses.name: The Old You
bosses.epithet: Scrawny. Stubborn. Knows all your moves.

out.name: The Old You
out.epithet: Scrawny. Stubborn. Knows all your moves.

out.name: Echo of Doubt I
out.epithet: The summit is behind you. The echoes never stop.

out.name: Echo of Doubt II
out.epithet: The summit is behind you. The echoes never stop.

out.name: Echo of Doubt IV
out.epithet: The summit is behind you. The echoes never stop.

out.name: Echo of Doubt V
out.epithet: The summit is behind you. The echoes never stop.

out.name: Echo of Doubt X
out.epithet: The summit is behind you. The echoes never stop.

out.name: Echo of Doubt 11
out.epithet: The summit is behind you. The echoes never stop.

out.name: Echo of Doubt 12
out.epithet: The summit is behind you. The echoes never stop.

out.name: Echo of Doubt 37
out.epithet: The summit is behind you. The echoes never stop.

achievements.name: Jack of All Trades
achievements.desc: Log a session in all four disciplines.

achievements.name: Two-a-Day
achievements.desc: Log two sessions on the same day.

achievements.name: Weekend Warrior
achievements.desc: Train on both Saturday and Sunday of the same week.

achievements.name: Triple Threat
achievements.desc: Train three different disciplines in one week.

achievements.name: Full House
achievements.desc: Train all four disciplines in one week.

achievements.name: Monthly Regular
achievements.desc: Log 12 sessions in one calendar month.

achievements.name: Machine
achievements.desc: Log 20 sessions in one calendar month.

achievements.name: On a Roll
achievements.desc: Hit your weekly goal 4 weeks in a row.

achievements.name: Unbreakable
achievements.desc: Hit your weekly goal 12 weeks in a row.

achievements.name: Half-Year Hero
achievements.desc: Hit your weekly goal 26 weeks in a row.

achievements.name: Iron Will
achievements.desc: Hit your weekly goal 52 weeks in a row.

achievements.name: Big Day
achievements.desc: Earn 3,000 XP in a single day.

achievements.name: Marathon Session
achievements.desc: Log a session lasting 2 hours or more.

achievements.name: Hat Trick
achievements.desc: Set three personal records in a single session.

achievements.name: Comeback Kid
achievements.desc: Come back and log a session after two weeks away. The door is always open.

achievements.name: Bodyweight Bench
achievements.desc: Bench press your own bodyweight. Needs a logged body weight.

achievements.name: V-Point Hoarder
achievements.desc: Send 50 V-points in one session (a V4 is 4 points).

achievements.name: Project Mode
achievements.desc: 10 attempts in one session. Respect the process.

achievements.name: Hill Hunter
achievements.desc: Climb 500 m of elevation in one run.

achievements.name: Vert Collector
achievements.desc: Climb 5,000 m of elevation lifetime on foot.

achievements.name: Imperial Century
achievements.desc: Ride 160 km (100 miles) in one go.

achievements.name: Mountain Goat
achievements.desc: Climb 1,000 m of elevation in one ride.

achievements.name: Everested
achievements.desc: Climb 8,848 m of elevation lifetime on the bike.

achievements.name: Fast Wheels
achievements.desc: Average 30 km/h over a 20 km+ ride.

achievements.name: Well Rounded
achievements.desc: Reach level 10 in all four disciplines.

achievements.name: Journeyman
achievements.desc: Reach the Journeyman rank in any discipline.

achievements.name: Expert
achievements.desc: Reach the Expert rank in any discipline.

achievements.name: Mastery
achievements.desc: Reach the Master rank in any discipline.

achievements.name: Titan Ascendant
achievements.desc: Defeat The Old You and clear Titan's Summit.

achievements.name: Baseline
achievements.desc: Log your body weight for the first time.

achievements.name: Say Cheese
achievements.desc: Take a full set of progress photos: front, side and back.

achievements.name: Checking In
achievements.desc: Check in four weeks in a row.

achievements.name: Accountable
achievements.desc: Check in twelve weeks in a row.

achievements.name: Half a Year in Frames
achievements.desc: Check in twenty-six weeks in a row.

items.name: Hand-Me-Down Tee
items.flavor: It has seen things. Mostly couches.

items.name: Gym Gloves
items.flavor: Protects the hands. Not the ego.

items.name: Wrist Wraps
items.flavor: Wrap it before you tap it.

items.name: Lifting Straps
items.flavor: Your grip gives out before your back does. Not anymore.

items.name: Iron Plate Pendant
items.flavor: A tiny 2.5 on a chain. Still counts.

items.name: Competition Singlet
items.flavor: Nowhere to hide. Nothing to hide.

items.name: Barbell of Burden
items.flavor: You carry it everywhere now. Metaphorically. And literally.

items.name: Crown of Iron
items.flavor: Heavy is the head. Heavier is the bar.

items.name: Crag Beanie
items.flavor: Worn indoors. Worn in summer. Worn always.

items.name: Approach Shoes
items.flavor: For the walk to the wall. The real workout.

items.name: Harness
items.flavor: Ready for ropes. Looks great over shorts.

items.name: Crash Pad
items.flavor: A mattress you carry up a hill. For fun.

items.name: Crimp Gauntlets
items.flavor: Tape on every finger. Skin is temporary.

items.name: Stone Fist Wraps
items.flavor: Your fingers are now a geological feature.

items.name: Granite Crown
items.hint: Reach climbing level 30 or send a V10
items.unlockHint: Reach climbing level 30 or send a V10

items.name: Race Visor
items.flavor: Lets the heat out. Keeps the focus in.

items.name: Compression Sleeves
items.flavor: Science says maybe. Vibes say yes.

items.name: Carbon Racers
items.flavor: They feel like cheating. They are not cheating.
items.hint: Run a half marathon (21.1 km) in one go
items.unlockHint: Run a half marathon (21.1 km) in one go

items.name: Marathon Medal
items.flavor: 42.195 km. Every one of them earned.
items.hint: Run a marathon (42.2 km) in one go
items.unlockHint: Run a marathon (42.2 km) in one go

items.name: Winged Sandals
items.hint: Reach running level 30 or run 1,000 km lifetime
items.unlockHint: Reach running level 30 or run 1,000 km lifetime

items.name: Saddle Bag
items.flavor: Two tubes, one lever, zero regrets.

items.name: Sport Shades
items.flavor: Looking fast is half the battle.

items.name: Clipless Shoes
items.flavor: Click. Clack. Fall over once. Pro.

items.name: Polka Dot Jersey
items.hint: Climb 10,000 m of elevation lifetime on the bike
items.unlockHint: Climb 10,000 m of elevation lifetime on the bike

items.name: Yellow Jersey
items.flavor: The maillot jaune. You know what it means.
items.hint: Reach cycling level 30 or ride 5,000 km lifetime
items.unlockHint: Reach cycling level 30 or ride 5,000 km lifetime

items.name: Training Hoodie
items.flavor: Hood up. Headphones in. Nobody talk to me.

items.name: Lucky Socks
items.flavor: Unwashed since the last PR. Loot loves them.

items.name: Aviators
items.flavor: The danger zone is wherever you train.

items.name: Galaxy Tights
items.flavor: Leg day, but make it cosmic.

items.name: Midnight Cape
items.flavor: For dramatic exits from the gym.

items.name: Golden Mitts
items.flavor: Everything you touch turns to gains.

items.name: Streak Flame
items.flavor: Eight weeks of fire. Can you feel it?

items.name: Titan Aura
items.flavor: The room gets brighter when you walk in.

items.name: Prismatic Aura
items.hint: Reach level 20 in all four disciplines
items.unlockHint: Reach level 20 in all four disciplines

items.name: Comfy Slippers
items.flavor: Looted from the Sunday Scaries. Dangerously cosy.

items.name: Wyvern-Scale Chalk Bag
items.flavor: The chalk never clumps. The scales never slip.

items.name: Wallbreaker Visor
items.flavor: Kilometre thirty-two never saw it coming.

items.name: Titan's Laurel
items.flavor: You beat the only opponent that ever mattered.

pets.name: Gloop
pets.flavor: Found under the squat rack. Very supportive.

pets.name: Crimpy
pets.flavor: Sticks to anything. Shows off about it.

pets.name: Sprout
pets.flavor: Grows a leaf every time you check in.
pets.hint: Check in (weight or photos) 4 weeks in a row

pets.name: Zoom
pets.flavor: Fast. Elegant. Naps 20 hours a day.

pets.name: Draft
pets.flavor: Rides your slipstream. Takes the KOM.

pets.name: Pebble
pets.flavor: A chip off the old Iron Golem. Followed you home.

pets.name: Steady
pets.flavor: Slow is smooth. Smooth is eight weeks straight.

pets.name: Deload
pets.flavor: Knocks loot off the shelf. Into your bag.

pets.name: Ember
pets.flavor: Half a year of fire, reborn weekly.

pets.name: Titan Jr.
pets.flavor: Tiny now. Give it a few hundred sessions.
